name: Dead Canary

features.name: xBomb cross blasts
features.description: Clear a cross pattern and raise the multiplier.

review:
A mine on an uneven 3-4-3-4-3-4 grid, with barriers blocking parts of the reels. Line up three to five matching symbols diagonally without a win and Wild Mining kicks in; scatters behind a barrier don't count until it's cleared.

xBomb wilds explode in a cross around themselves, clearing symbols and boosting the multiplier. The bonus is Canary Freespins. Extreme volatility, 65,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
